searchTerms.title: Search terms
searchTerms.description: Keywords to look up, e.g. pickleball, air fryer, chatgpt.

compareTerms.title: Compare terms against each other
compareTerms.description: On: terms are sent to Google together (up to 5 per comparison), so their values are relative to one another, as in the Trends compare view. Off: each term is scaled 0-100 on its own.

geo.title: Region
geo.description: Country or subregion code: US, GB, DE, US-CA, US-NY. Empty for worldwide.

timeRange.title: Time range
timeRange.description: Ignored when start and end dates are set.

startDate.title: Start date (custom range)
startDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Set both dates for a custom range.

searchType.title: Search type
searchType.description: Which Google search the interest comes from: web (default), images, news, YouTube or Shopping.

category.title: Category ID
category.description: Google Trends category, e.g. 0 all, 7 Finance, 71 Food & Drink, 958 Travel. 0 for all.

interestOverTime.title: Interest over time
interestOverTime.description: The time series, with a summary: average, latest, peak and date, and whether interest is rising, falling or flat.

interestByRegion.title: Interest by region
interestByRegion.description: Where the term is searched most, 0-100 per country, state, city or metro.

regionResolution.title: Region level
regionResolution.description: Countries, subregions (states), cities or US metro areas. Empty lets Google choose for the region you picked.

relatedQueries.title: Related queries (top and rising)
relatedQueries.description: What people also search: the top queries, and the rising ones with their growth.

trendingNow.title: Trending Now searches
trendingNow.description: Also return today's trending searches with traffic and news links for the countries below.

trendingGeos.title: Trending Now countries
trendingGeos.description: Country codes, e.g. US, GB, IN, DE.
